shows.title: Aladdin
shows.subtitle: and the Tales of 1001 Nights
shows.logline: A lamp, a wish, a cave of gold, and a storyteller who never runs out of nights.
synopsis: Scheherazade spins one tale into the next: Aladdin and the lamp that grants any wish, Ali Baba at the mouth of the treasure cave, Sinbad facing the storm.
Oriental rhythm meets modern score. Skaters, aerialists on silk high above the rink, fire jugglers and acrobats turn the ice into a desert, a palace and an open sea.

shows.title: Dracula
shows.subtitle: The Story of Eternal Love
shows.logline: Some loves outlive the night. Some outlive everything.
synopsis: A gothic city under red lanterns, a castle above the clouds, a love that refuses to die. The legend of Count Dracula told as a dark romance on ice.
An original rock-opera score, aerial work on blood-red silk, fire and fog: the darkest and most cinematic show in the repertoire.

shows.title: Alice
shows.subtitle: in Wonderland
shows.logline: Follow the rabbit. Mind the cards. Never trust the time.
synopsis: A girl falls through the ice into a world where cards march, roses blush on command and every clock is late.
A wild tea party, a furious queen and a garden of glass, staged as a whirl of colour and speed.

shows.title: Anastasia
shows.subtitle: The Secret Heir
shows.logline: A ballroom frozen in time. A girl who has to remember who she is.
synopsis: Years after the last waltz in the palace, a young woman with no past hears a melody she somehow knows.
A story of memory and courage that moves from candlelit ballrooms to the snow of a long journey home.

shows.subtitle: A new production
shows.logline: One rose, one fox, a thousand stars.
